title: A Strange Death at the Lake Resort
briefing: At an exclusive lakeside retreat, a venture capitalist collapsed on the private pier after a midnight toast. Four associates were in the pavilion, and one of them is guilty.
setting: Misty Pines Lake Resort, Boathouse Pier

suspects.name: Evelyn Cross
suspects.publicStatement: I was checking investor correspondence in the study lounge.
suspects.background: Co-founder facing a hostile board buyout.

suspects.name: Dr. Ronald Hayes
suspects.publicStatement: I was in the guest cottage preparing medication records.
suspects.background: Longtime personal doctor to the Stone family.

alibiTimeline.label: Ran to pier with emergency bag

suspects.name: Garrick Shaw
suspects.publicStatement: I was monitoring camera perimeters from the boathouse gate.

suspects.name: Chloe Bennett
suspects.publicStatement: I was washing dessert ramekins and clearing the galley kitchen.
suspects.background: Rising culinary chef hired for the weekend.

clues.title: Automated Study Router Log
clues.description: Network traffic demonstrates Evelyn's laptop ran a scheduled auto-script, with zero mouse activity between 11:40 and 12:10 AM.
clues.insight: Dismantles Evelyn's claim that she was actively typing emails in the study.

clues.title: Digital Pill Dispenser Record
clues.description: Automated biometric timestamps confirm Dr. Hayes locked the medical box and never opened it during the toast.
clues.insight: Exonerates Dr. Hayes by proving prescription compounds were untouched.

clues.title: Galley Dishwasher Timer
clues.description: Continuous high-temp wash cycle and CCTV in the kitchen confirm Chloe remained at the prep sinks.
clues.insight: Corroborates Chloe's whereabouts throughout the relevant window.

clues.title: Bodyguard Tactical Pocket Knife
clues.description: A folding tactical blade belonging to Garrick found wedged between pier planks.
clues.insight: Appears suspicious, but Garrick used it to free tangled fishing line earlier that evening.

clues.title: Kitchen Truffle Receipt
clues.description: An invoice for bitter almond extract ordered for dessert flavoring.
clues.insight: Shows toxic-smelling kitchen supplies, but chemical tests reveal standard baking almond.

clues.title: Amber Vial Residue
clues.description: A discarded glass dropper containing synthetic aconite, bearing fingerprint ridges matching Evelyn.
clues.insight: Directly links Evelyn to the poisonous substance introduced into the champagne flute.

clues.title: Hostile Buyout Agreement
clues.description: Documents proving Stone had voted to strip Evelyn of her equity stakes effective the following morning.
clues.insight: Provides motive regarding imminent financial and reputational ruin.

motive: To stop Geoffrey Stone from filing a fraud report and revoking her partnership shares.
method: Set up a fake computer activity script, dosed his private glass with aconite on the pier.
opportunity: Familiarity with the boathouse pathway enabled slipping down to the pier unseen.

deduction.conclusion: Router activity reveals Evelyn used an automated script to manufacture her digital alibi.
The amber dropper discovered near the pier connects Evelyn to the aconite poison.
The buyout agreement demonstrates Evelyn had urgent motive to eliminate Stone before morning.

timeline.event: Evelyn launches the script in the study and slips out the rear door.
Evelyn adds the aconite droplets to the champagne glass.
Evelyn tosses the vial into the shrubs and returns to the lodge.

hints.text: Scrutinize electronic alibis to see if active human interaction really occurred.
Search the foliage near the pier pathway for discarded containers.
Examine partnership agreements to uncover who stood to lose everything at dawn.
